blurb: Guests fish for salmon, trout, and walleye on Lake Huron aboard the Emma J, a long range charter fishing boat. Trips include options for half day fishing or combined half day fishing and half day touring Mackinac Island. Families and seasoned sport fishermen are welcome, with drop off service for non-fishermen to tour the island.
